summary: Constructor/initializer on an unknown __thiscall object (called by ShortComputation_b360 0045b360 and sub_49B0A0). Zero-fills the first eight dwords (offsets 0x0 through 0x1C), writes 1065353216 (single-precision 1.0) into offsets 0x20 and 0x24, and returns 1065353216. No reads and no globals.

local_names.this: object whose ten leading dwords are initialized

operations.description: Zero the first eight dwords of the object: this[0] through this[7] (offsets 0x0 through 0x1C).
Write 1065353216 (the single-precision bit pattern of 1.0) into this[8] at offset 0x20.

unresolved: The object type is unidentified; the write-only pattern is consistent with a constructor/initializer (prelabel category ctor_init) but no owner identity is evidenced.
The meaning of the eight zeroed fields and the two fields initialized to 1.0 is unknown.
The purpose of returning 1065353216 is not evidenced; the value may be a decompiler artifact of the register that held the last write.
